name: OW3-J1-bare-interrupt
note: The view brought down interrupts past the panel: the journey still reads active, the view rises again over it, the held map never offers Resume.

name: OW3-J1-rises-over-a-stop
note: The view is raised over a panel left up with nothing driving - a frozen journey.

name: OW3-J1-pause-closes-nothing
note: The mod's own pause stops the walk and leaves its panel up: the journey reads active.

name: OW3-J2-teleport-past-the-peaks
note: A walked trip the Overworld refused falls through to DFU's fast travel - a paid teleport past the mountain rule.

name: OW3-J2-said-twice
note: A coordinate pick the Overworld refused (and said why) is also told 'You cannot travel there now.'

name: OW3-J2-no-owner
note: The enhanced interface's walked trip is nobody's: the map's pick goes the classic ground journey's way, and a refusal teleports.

name: OW3-J3-no-rejoin
note: A resume heads straight for the run's far end, beside the road.

name: OW3-J3-join-never-walked
note: The rejoin is computed and never aimed at.

name: OW3-J3-join-never-spent
note: The join, reached, is aimed at again and again - the leg after it never begun.

name: OW3-J3-join-in-the-legs-pixel
old: const j = r.join, jp = worldCoordToMapPixel(j.x, j.z);
note: The join is aimed in the leg's pixel: the autopilot asks for its arrival where the join is not, and walks past it.

name: OW3-J3-open-ground-rejoined
note: A journey across country is detoured to a line no road runs along.

name: OW3-J3-join-at-the-end
old: && Math.hypot(j.x - end.x, j.z - end.z) > P_SIZE / 2 ? j : null;
note: A rejoin at the run's own end is a second target on the leg's own point.

name: OW3-J3-stale-join-walked
note: A traveller knocked out of the start pixel walks back to where the old join lay, not to the road nearest them.

name: OW3-J3-line-beside
note: The view's line runs straight to the leg's end while the walk rejoins the road first.

name: OW3-J4-spot-line-straight
old: tvTrip.natives = routeDrawPoints(state.worldCoords(player.pos), legs, { x: n.x, z: n.z }, tvLegMid);
new: tvTrip.natives = routeDrawPoints(state.worldCoords(player.pos), [], { x: n.x, z: n.z }, tvLegMid);
note: A spot's drawn route is [traveller, spot]: the routed walk leaves it at its first bend.

name: OW3-J4-last-leg-drawn
note: The last leg's pixel middle is drawn before the end: the line doubles through the place's middle and the leg index cuts it one short.

name: OW3-J5-start-exempt-again
note: The step out of the start is exempt again: a one-pixel ridge beside it is crossed, a cliff beside it climbed.

name: OW3-J5-plateau-climbed
note: The step onto a spot is never asked: a plateau is walked straight up its cliff (Mac's lag and fall).

name: OW3-J5-spot-goal-exempt
old: let plan = planRoute(from, pix, { roads: wnet?.roads ?? null, tracks: wnet?.tracks ?? null, ...tvRouteGround(), goalExempt: !!door, sea: seaAsk });
new: let plan = planRoute(from, pix, { roads: wnet?.roads ?? null, tracks: wnet?.tracks ?? null, ...tvRouteGround(), sea: seaAsk });
note: The spot's journey exempts its last step: up the plateau's cliff.

name: OW3-J6-mw-body-ungrown
old: grow: face?.grow > 1 ? face.grow : 1, up: face?.up ?? null });
note: Under the travel view the Morrowind body stays a speck at its own size.

name: OW3-J6-grow-ignored
note: drawThird is handed the view's grow and draws the body at its own size.

name: OW3-J6-depth-sliced
note: A grown body's picture keeps the fixed 4 m eye and 0.1..8 m planes: sliced front and back.

name: OW3-J7-walked-into-the-sea
old: if (tvWater(pick.pixel.x, pick.pixel.y) || at[1] <= tvSeaY() + TV_SEA_EPS_M) { tvSay(TRAVEL_VIEW_TEXT.water); return false; }
note: A held map's coordinate pick on the sea walks the traveller out into it.

name: OW3-J7-sea-pixel-walked
note: A sea pixel whose middle the far ring's clamp stands at a hair over the surface is walked into.
